_documentation.description: Provides stable Conquest Codex website identities, player-facing titles, and featured Warlord references for game Stories. RanseiLink does not expose every player-facing Story title or featured Warlord directly, so this file is generated as a starter template and then manually reviewed.
_documentation.mappingKey: Each key under mappings is storyIndex from raw/stories.json. storyIndex is the authoritative game-local connector.

fields.websiteId: Stable website route ID for the Story. Equivalent Stories should use the same websiteId across games when cross-game switching should preserve the selected Story.
fields.displayName: Player-facing Story title displayed by Conquest Codex. The generated value is only a starter and should be manually replaced with the actual Story title.
fields.warlords: Featured Warlords whose story the Story follows. Each array entry uses warriorIndex as the authoritative connector to raw/warriors.json and warriorName for human readability. The generated template includes one example entry for each Story and two example entries for Story index 0.

_documentation.maintenance: Generate this file once per game, manually review every entry, and do not rerun with --force after manual edits unless the game's Story roster has changed and replacing the reviewed mappings is intentional.
